main_result.title: A nested one-sided cluster e-test can be inverted into an anytime upper confidence sequence with no extra alpha penalty at the target tolerance; the real additional assumption is stable cross-cluster conditional mean, not 'full CS costs more'.

changes: Added inversion of the monotone nested tolerance tests into anytime_upper_endpoint_stable_p.

Tightened the parameter contract: the upper endpoint targets a stable conditional-mean parameter p inside a frozen fingerprint/lease, E[Y_t|F_{t-1}]=p. Arbitrary cross-cluster drift is not an average-mean estimate under this tool.
Kept the fixed-tolerance test under the weaker one-sided condition E[Y_t|past]>=tolerance whenever H0 is true.
Explicitly states that lower-level records remain nested inside one top-level cluster and do not become independent trials.

derivation.monotonicity: For fixed Y_t in [0,1], d e_t / d m = gamma*(1-Y_t)/(1-m)^2 >= 0. Products and fixed mixtures therefore remain nondecreasing in m.
derivation.confidence_set: C_t={m in [0,1]: E_t(m)<1/alpha}. Under the stable true p, E_t(p) is an e-process, so P(exists t: p notin C_t)<=alpha. Monotonicity makes C_t an interval from 0 up to an upper endpoint U_t.
derivation.equivalence: For any predeclared tolerance m0, U_t<=m0 exactly when the nested m0 e-test has crossed 1/alpha (up to numerical boundary convention). Therefore generating the full endpoint does not spend extra alpha at m0.
derivation.scope: This equivalence is for the same nested e-process family. It does not imply that all confidence-sequence constructions have identical power or that an arbitrary non-nested set of tests can be inverted without care.

correction_to_prior_checkpoint.superseded_statement: checkpoint_2026-08-27T150525_JST_cluster_aware_nondeterminism_trace.json said the threshold-specific e-test could be materially cheaper because it was not a full upper confidence-sequence endpoint.
correction_to_prior_checkpoint.correction: That comparison mixed two different e-process families. The prior Bernoulli beta-binomial CS needed 680 zero mismatches to reach 1%, while the new bounded cluster mixture crosses at 378; but once the new nested family itself is inverted, its upper endpoint also reaches 1% at the same 378 clusters. The gain is from the chosen betting family/contract, not an inherent multiplicity cost of asking for an upper CS.
correction_to_prior_checkpoint.do_not_generalize: The cluster mixture assumes a stable conditional-mean p for its upper endpoint. The earlier beta-binomial Bernoulli CS had its own point-null contract. Efficiency comparisons must hold the estimand and model contract fixed.

measurement_validity_rules: Do not attribute a power difference to 'point test versus confidence sequence' when the procedures use different e-process families or different statistical contracts.

When tests are nested and monotone in the candidate parameter, inversion can provide a time-uniform confidence endpoint without a Bonferroni-style continuum penalty; validity at the true parameter is enough for coverage.
Separate stable fingerprint-level mismatch-rate inference from inference on a time-average of drifting conditional mismatch rates.
A fingerprint lease that changes environment/runtime should invalidate the stable-p interpretation rather than silently extending the same confidence sequence.
scope_guards: The numerical endpoints were checked worker-locally from the committed formula; they are not empirical runtime mismatch measurements.
The current upper endpoint is for a stable conditional-mean parameter. It is not yet a CS for arbitrary average conditional means under drift.
No forbidden semantic inputs were read.

frontier.action: Add a separate average-conditional-mean confidence sequence for heterogeneous/drifting process clusters, and compare its assumptions/cost with stable-p lease invalidation rather than overloading one estimator.
Design a process/server-lifetime fingerprint lease protocol that resets or quarantines stable-p evidence on observed config/runtime drift without resetting lifetime false-certification budget.
Continue seeking public complete repeated-output traces or frozen scorer labels so raw divergence can be propagated to decision-statistic mismatch rather than left UNKNOWN.

Compare alternative predictable betting mixtures for rare zero/sparse-mismatch clusters under a fixed common-p contract, optimizing expected cluster count without selecting bets after seeing the current outcome.

exact_next_action: Implement a distinct average-conditional-mean CS for bounded process-level cluster scores so nonstationary mismatch burden can be estimated without pretending the fingerprint has a constant p.
